title: Hongzhi, Part 3: Guidepost For The Hall Of Pure Bliss
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett reflects on the importance of balance between serenity and illumination, encouraging listeners to cultivate inner clarity and wonder through practices like meditation and non-verbal communication. They emphasize that responding without falling into achievement is key to achieving serenity, but also acknowledge the need for balance with insight. By embracing both opposites - what's good and what's bad - we can develop a more nuanced and compassionate understanding of the world.
